x.name: Aaron Levie
x.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI

tweets.text:
Huge opportunity right now to build new services firms from the ground up, or transform existing ones, with agents at the center. 

The expertise that services firms in theory should have is as important as ever because you still need deep domain understanding to get the most out of agents. But now the ability to deliver on projects has a 10X multiplier. This means that you can make clients happier, compete to win more of them, go after smaller customers not in the TAM before, or deliver outcomes that weren’t really conceivable.

This is going to happen in advertising, IT transformation, management consulting, finance, and a number of other fields that historically are just fully constrained by the speed of their workforce for output. 

This is a huge opportunity right now for those starting these firms. I wouldn’t count out existing players that commit to the transformation either as existing customer trust goes a long way. But they have to move quickly to make it work.

x.name: Sam Altman
x.bio: The mission of OpenAI is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity

tweets.text:
Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millenium prize problems.

There are a lot of brilliant people in the world, but being brilliant and also having correctly-placed confidence and courage to keep pushing on something that others don't think is possible is a very valuable thing and fairly rare.

I am grateful so many people at OpenAI have this combination.

Oh, one thing about kids:

Most good things get a little less satisfying the 100th time you do them.

A quiet evening hanging out with your kids, even doing very mundane stuff, is in the rare category of something repetitive just getting better and better.

I am thankful for a lot of things in life, but my family is the best thing that has ever happened to me.

The two most common things people said to me before having kids is that it's better than anyone can explain to you and it goes very fast; these are both true and I don't have much to add. But I am very grateful and I love them more than there is any way to explain.

Also I cannot really imagine life without Ollie and I think without his unwavering support and great advice I would have gone crazy by now.

🦃
